'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Peter Tenneson LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Tenneson]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Username:''' patmagroin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
